stories.testimonial: I always believed that finding the right life partner was about destiny — and Make My Knot proved me right. Meeting Muskan felt like meeting someone I had known forever. What impressed me most was how the platform respected both families' expectations while giving us the space to know each other. Today, Muskan and I are starting a new chapter together, and we're grateful to Make My Knot for being the bridge that turned destiny into reality.

For me, marriage was never just about finding a partner — it was about finding someone who would fit beautifully into my family too. When I met Aishwarya through Make My Knot, I felt that connection instantly. She wasn't just perfect for me, she was loved and welcomed by my parents from the very first meeting.

I wasn't expecting much when I first got introduced to Khyati through Make My Knot. But what surprised me was how naturally our conversations flowed — like talking to an old friend. Slowly, that comfort turned into trust, and trust turned into love.

When I met Barkha through Make My Knot, I felt something I had never felt before — a sense of comfort, like I had found a missing piece of my life. Our conversations flowed so naturally, and with every step, I realized she was exactly the partner I had been hoping for.

threeGenerations.title: 50 Years of Trust, Three Generations of Love
threeGenerations.description: For five decades, the Goyal family has been weaving love stories across India. What began as a traditional matchmaking service has evolved into a pioneering AI-powered platform, but our core values remain unchanged: authentic connections, family harmony, and lasting relationships built on deep compatibility.

ourStory.title: Our Story
ourStory.content: It was 1974 when Dadu, Chaman Prakash Goyal, first realized his calling. A young man in his village couldn't find a suitable match despite being from a good family. Dadu spent weeks traveling from village to village, meeting families, understanding their values, and finally found the perfect match. The wedding was celebrated for days, and both families blessed Dadu for bringing such joy into their lives. That day, he knew his purpose: to unite hearts that were meant to be together.
ourStory.philosophy: "A good marriage isn't about finding the perfect person, but about becoming the perfect match for each other." - Chaman Prakash Goyal
